tools.name: find_bank
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a US bank is FDIC insured, or needs its FDIC certificate number, legal name, primary regulator, total assets, office count or website. Searches live FDIC BankFind records by name (optionally narrowed by state and city), by city and state, or by certificate number;
